definitions.explanation: Understanding and accepting something; giving one's agreement or acknowledgment.
An acknowledgment that a message has been received and understood, commonly used in professional/military contexts.

examples.notes: {承知|しょうち}しました is considered more appropriate when speaking to superiors.

notes:
USAGE NOTES:
- {了解|りょうかい} as a response (sense 2) is very common in business and casual contexts.
- Some argue that using {了解|りょうかい} to superiors is inappropriate and that ⟦{承知|しょうち}→承知：02086_shouchi⟧しました is more polite, though this distinction is debated.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {了解|りょうかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to understand, to consent)
- {了解|りょうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (to obtain consent)
- {了解|りょうかい}⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧ (understood/acknowledged)
- {了解|りょうかい}⟦です→だ：noentry⟧ (understood)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{承知|しょうち}→承知：02086_shouchi⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧ - understood (more formal/humble)
- ⟦{分|わ}かりました→分かる：noentry⟧ - I understand (neutral)
- ⟦かしこまりました→かしこまる：noentry⟧ - certainly (very formal/service industry)
